headline: Meta Defies Brazil’s Order on Political Fairness
lede: Brazil’s electoral court ordered Meta to explain and equalize how Instagram and WhatsApp surface political content. The company now faces escalating daily fines as investigators examine examples involving Lula, Bolsonaro, and Meta AI.

headline: Build the Software We Once Thought Impossible
lede: Cheaper implementation changes the boundary of what a small team can attempt. But ambitious software still needs benchmarks, domain knowledge, and the patience to discover where AI-generated code breaks.
pullquote: The cost of trying ambitious software has fallen; the cost of understanding it has not.

headline: Cerebras Runs Trillion-Parameter Models Across Wafer-Scale Chips
lede: Cerebras splits enormous models across dozens of wafer-scale processors, keeping layers resident in local SRAM and passing activations through a pipeline. The design makes memory movement—not merely arithmetic—the central problem of inference at this scale.

headline: France Prepared a Switch for Social Platforms
lede: French operators were asked to ready temporary DNS blocks for TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, and X during anticipated demonstrations. The plan was never activated, and its technical limits—and legal questions—were apparent from the start.

headline: Bonito, Smoke-Dried the Old Way
lede: At a fifth-generation workshop founded in 1882, bonito becomes katsuobushi through months of boiling, smoking, fermentation, and sun-drying. The result is less a recipe than a preserved industrial ritual, still practiced by only a handful of makers.

headline: Goose Rethinks Memory Without a Heap
lede: Goose puts dynamically sized values on compiler-managed data stacks and removes garbage collection, reference counting, and lifetime annotations. It compiles to C, promises predictable layouts, and accepts whole-program constraints in exchange for control.

headline: A Commercial 3D Engine Rewritten in Jai
lede: Polygon’s author rebuilt a TypeScript and Electron engine in Jai to gain explicit allocation, steadier performance, and cleaner native deployment. Two years of reconstruction produced a new renderer, engine architecture, and procedural toolset.

headline: Cannabis Sales Track Higher Cardiac Admissions
lede: A study of more than 50 million hospital discharges finds year-over-year increases in several cardiovascular admissions after recreational cannabis sales began. The regional, observational design identifies an association, not a cause, and leaves substantial confounding to resolve.

headline: SpeedCrunch Returns With Fifty-Digit Precision
lede: SpeedCrunch 1.1 brings its cross-platform scientific calculator another release, with complex numbers, units, programmable functions, and up to 50-digit precision. It remains a compact desktop instrument for calculations that ordinary calculator apps leave unfinished.

headline: The Quiet Power of Small Programs
lede: Tiny interpreters, ray tracers, and compact languages make computing small enough to hold in the mind. Their value is not only efficiency: they expose the minimum machinery behind an idea and invite the reader to rebuild it.
